prompt:
Create ONE ORIGINAL NABO major-arcana card ILLUSTRATION, a finished flat-color 2D game artwork. The supplied image is the strict NABO IDENTITY AND COSTUME reference, not an existing tarot deck. Preserve the same youthful face, large blue-gray eyes, thin round dark glasses, tousled dark-brown hair, WHITE CAP with the original readable blue heartbeat NABO logo in its correct unmirrored orientation. Keep the established large-head chibi proportions and fully opaque pale-lavender open over-robe over deep-purple Taoist cross-collar robe with crisp cyan edging (costume C). Do not replace the character with a generic anime child; no new headwear or medical accessories.
Portrait 1024x1536 composition. Character's head/face is LARGE and clear, around 40 percent of image height; complete cap and hair inside safe margin. Readability at 70px illustration width matters: broad simple silhouettes, very few folds, at most THREE background/scene motifs. Full-body poses may use a tiny compact body while retaining the big head. Character and essential props occupy the central 90 percent of the image. Background is a single flat dark-indigo #0D0820 field with only the scene motifs specified below.
Use uniform flat fills plus ONE crisp cel-shadow per material, dark local-color outlines. Main palette matches reference; use gold #FFC94A, cyan #35F0DC, purple, magenta #FF3DA6 and parchment accents. No gradients, realistic rendering, soft blush, blur, glow, dithering or texture.
NO frame, border, card title, number, Roman numeral, captions or writing: exact project border and blank title panels will be composited separately. The existing NABO cap mark is the ONLY allowed lettering. Entire illustration is original: do not reproduce ANY existing tarot deck composition. No extra symbolism beyond the described scene.
SCENE: NABO floats peacefully UPSIDE DOWN inside one cyan anti-gravity octagonal capsule, knees comfortably tucked and hands loosely relaxed, showing a changed perspective. The cap stays attached and its NABO logo rotates naturally with the head, NEVER mirror it. Original space-pod composition, no rope, gallows, tree or classic one-leg hanging pose. Keep face large and recognizable despite inversion.
